text: Oh! Hello. Sorry, I didn't hear the door. Are you new? You look new. I don't mean that badly.
I'm Wren. I'm the one everybody here beats, so I'm the one who explains things.
Have you played before? Be honest, nobody minds.

choices.text: Never. I don't know the rules.
I know how the stones work.
A bit. Remind me how capturing works.

text: Oh, good. Then I'll skip the speech. Ask me if you ever want it, I do like giving it.
That's the rulebook, near enough. Liberties, capture, and don't fill in your own last one.
Everything else is those three, said at length.
Same three rules as last time. Sorry, I do go on.
That's ko. You can't take it straight back. Go and do something else first, then come back for it.
There's a beginners' tournament at the Bondszaal, the Cup. You need a rank to enter. You get one by playing.
That's Kesh by the window. She'll play anyone, and she remembers every result.
Do you want me to explain how a game ends? People find that bit odd.
When neither of you wants to play a move, you both pass. Then you count your empty points and your captures.
White gets a few extra points for going second. Highest total wins.
Good. That's the right attitude, and I don't have it.
Go on. She's already looking at you.
Kesh is by the window. She's been waiting since you came in, she just won't say so.

choices.text: Could you go over the rules again?

text: Go on, then.
Of course. Which bit has gone?
It does that. It goes, and then one day it stops going.
You beat Kesh? I've played her eleven times. Don't ask my record.
She'll want a rematch. She won't say so.
Would you play me? I've been the same rank for a year and everyone here is lovely about it.
Lovely is worse. You're about my strength, so it'd be a real game.

exit.intro: Wren. She has moved the bowls twice.

choices.text: Could you go over the rules again?

text: Again? Yes. Obviously yes.
I've started writing them down. Not a score, a record. Kesh has ruined me.

exit.intro: Wren again. She has the black bowl before you sit down.

choices.text: Could you go over the rules again?

text: That's fine. That's completely fine. I'll be here.
Oh, before you go. I said that was the whole rulebook, and it was very slightly a lie.
There's one more rule, the strange one. Ko.
That's fair. You don't need it until it happens to you, and then you want it badly.
You got me. I saw it coming for four moves and played somewhere else anyway.
That was good. I'm saying that as the person who just lost, so you can believe it.
I won. Sorry. Sorry. I WON.
Play me again in a bit? While I still have the nerve.
